joints.J2: curved rail about the J2 axis: carriage (link 2) on a 2-stage telescopic rail (stage 2 = group l3, driven at half the carriage travel)

note: NOT MVP1-legal: stage 2 of the telescopic rail must be synchronised 2:1 with the carriage (cable loop with pulleys or a rack and pinion = gearing, both ruled out for MVP1; a floating stage would be an undriven coordinate, R17). R17's dynamics judge models the orientation-equivalent spherical 3R (kinematics); stage 2 (group l3) is not in its MuJoCo model.
